<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1041
Claimant:
Samuel Carter
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
28 Feb 2024
First notice of loss received for a low-speed collision in a parking lot. The insured's vehicle was struck while
stationary, and the claimant reports a knee injury and is represented by counsel, so all contact will go through the
attorney's office.
15 Mar 2024
Police report and two independent witnesses confirm the claimant was seated in the vehicle at the time of the impact.
The other driver's statement matches the account given to us, and scene photos are in the file.
1 Apr 2024
Reviewed the vehicle damage photos. The damage is mostly consistent with the impact described, and the estimate
has been sent for review. No earlier damage to the vehicle appears in our records or in the shop history provided. The
driver is listed on the policy, and nothing suggests the damage predates the coverage start.
2 Apr 2024
Attorney provided the medical summary. The knee injury fits the kind and force of the crash, and no prior injury to the
same area is known. Teratment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
12 May 2024
Recorded a follow-up statement from the claimant. Some small details were added since the first report, but the core
account of how the collision happened has stayed the same and lines up with the witnesses and photos.
7 Jun 2024
Medical treatment has tapered and the file is nearing a settlement evaluation. All parties have confirmed the accident
occurred as described, and the claim is being routed to the bodily injury and property damage teams for final review.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
